questions.question: Which edition do the quotes on this page praise?
questions.explanation: The heading reads 'Praise for the Second Edition'. You are reading the third edition; the first edition is not mentioned here.

questions.question: According to Martin Görner, how does Chollet handle mathematics?
questions.answer: He cuts through the math with practical Python code.
questions.explanation: Görner's quote: 'explains complex concepts with minimal fuss, cutting through the math with practical Python code.'

questions.question: What does 'democratization of AI' mean in the context of this book?
questions.answer: Making deep learning accessible to many people — not only specialists — through approachable explanations and easy-to-use tools like Keras.
questions.explanation: Kjell Jansson's quote uses the phrase; the preface (p.18) states the aim of broadening access and putting deep learning 'into the hands of millions of people'.

questions.question: Which theme is NOT among the reviewers' comments on this page?
options: The book is useful to both novices and experienced professionals
The book contains lots of real-world examples
The book provides formal proofs of convergence
The book explains concepts with practical Python code
questions.answer: The book provides formal proofs of convergence
questions.explanation: The quotes praise pedagogy, real-world examples and accessibility; none mention formal proofs — the book deliberately avoids heavy notation (p.20).

questions.question: Given that the book favors code over math, how will you study it — will you run each listing as you read?
questions.answer: Open-ended; the authors strongly recommend running and modifying the examples (p.22).
questions.explanation: 'About the code' (p.22) suggests running, modifying and playing with the examples to build intuition.

questions.question: Where is the publisher, Manning, located according to the title page?
questions.explanation: The title page reads 'MANNING Shelter Island'; the copyright page (p.6) gives the full address in Shelter Island, NY 11964.

questions.question: What is the full title as given on the title page?
options: Deep Learning with Python, Third Edition
questions.answer: Deep Learning with Python, Third Edition
questions.explanation: The title page reads exactly 'Deep Learning with Python, Third Edition'. The other options are not the title of this book.

questions.question: Which two people are credited as authors?
questions.explanation: Both names appear on the title page and on the cover (p.1).

questions.question: Why do books distinguish the title page from the cover?
questions.answer: The cover is a design element that may change across printings; the title page is the authoritative bibliographic source used for cataloging and citation.
questions.explanation: Note (not in the book): standard publishing convention.

questions.question: Could you write a full citation for this book from the title page and the copyright page?
questions.answer: Yes, e.g.: Chollet, F., & Watson, M. (2026). Deep Learning with Python (3rd ed.). Manning.
questions.explanation: The year comes from the copyright line on p.6.

questions.question: What is the copyright year and ISBN of this edition?
questions.explanation: Both are printed on the copyright page.

questions.question: What does the ∞ symbol next to the paper policy indicate?
options: The book is printed on acid-free paper
The book has an unlimited license
The book will be updated forever
questions.answer: The book is printed on acid-free paper
questions.explanation: The symbol introduces the statement that Manning prints on acid-free paper. It has nothing to do with licensing, edition count or online access.

questions.question: What should you do if a code example fails because a library has changed since publication?
questions.answer: Check the official code repository and errata (see p.22) — the disclaimer notes information was correct at press time only.
questions.explanation: The disclaimer limits responsibility to press-time correctness; p.22 points to maintained code online.

questions.question: Do you know where to find the book's official code and the free online edition?
questions.answer: Code: Manning website and GitHub (p.22); free online edition: deeplearningwithpython.io (p.18).
questions.explanation: Both are described in the front matter.
